skill.name: compile
skill.description: Use the SpecStream connector to turn a plain-English web data request into a specification you can review before collection starts.
skill.summary: Preview what SpecStream would collect, which conditions are required, and how many results you requested.
skill.author: specstream

remediation.suggestion: Disclose the transfer before the connector call. Ask users to remove sensitive information and confirm they want to send the request.

content.value_statement: A plain-English request can leave required filters and result details unclear. Compile uses the SpecStream connector to show how it interpreted your request before collection starts.
actual_capabilities: Restate the requested record type, filters, fields, and result count.
Separate mandatory conditions from optional result details.
Apply a deliberate change to a specification with the connector.
List existing request templates by record type.
Revise, branch, compare, or share a saved request through SpecStream.
limitations: Requires a configured SpecStream MCP connector.
The connector receives the request during preview.
A preview neither collects records nor verifies how many matches exist.
Searches for people by job title may return few results.

use_cases.title: Review public grant criteria
use_cases.description: Check that eligibility and deadline filters remain required while award amounts stay optional.

use_cases.title: Prepare a supplier request
use_cases.description: Confirm the service area, required certification, and target count before collecting public supplier listings.

use_cases.title: Compare two event requests
use_cases.description: Branch a saved request for public event listings and compare how a new date range changes the specification.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a simple request
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview my request for 10 public library listings in Seattle. Restate the record type, location, and count without collecting results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review the scope of a short request.

prompt_templates.title: Separate rules and details
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview a request for 15 public grants open to nonprofits. Require a published deadline and include award amounts when available. Do not start collection.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Check that a required condition stays separate from an optional field.

prompt_templates.title: Revise a single condition
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit my saved public event request to require events starting in June. Keep the venue rules, return fields, and result count unchanged. Restate the revised request.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Update one part of a saved specification.

prompt_templates.title: Compare a branched request
prompt_templates.prompt: Branch my saved public event request and extend only the date range into July. Compare the branch with the original, and do not start collection.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare a proposed change while preserving the original.

output_examples.input: Preview 15 public grants open to nonprofits with published deadlines. Include award amounts if available.
output: Record type: public grant listings. Requested count: 15.
Required: open to nonprofits and has a published deadline.
Optional detail: award amount. Collection has not started.

output_examples.input: Branch my June event request to include July. Keep the venue rules and count the same.
output: The original request still covers June only.
The branch covers June and July. Venue rules and requested count are unchanged.

best_practices: Name the record type and give a target result count.
Label mandatory conditions and optional fields separately.
Remove sensitive information before sending a request to the connector.
anti_patterns: Treating a preview as proof that matching records exist.
Removing a mandatory condition without asking the requester.
Treating missing evidence as proof that a condition is not met.

faq.question: Does a preview start data collection?
faq.answer: No. A preview restates the specification without starting collection.

faq.question: Does a preview send my request anywhere?
faq.answer: Yes. The configured SpecStream MCP server receives your request to interpret it.

faq.question: How do I sign in?
faq.answer: Use the connector's sign-in flow. Do not paste an API key into chat.

faq.question: Can I change a request after viewing it?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a specific edit, or branch a saved request to preserve the original.

faq.question: What if I do not know how to phrase my request?
faq.answer: Ask for existing SpecStream templates for the type of record you need.

faq.question: Does the requested count guarantee that many matches?
faq.answer: No. The count is a target, and searches for people by job title may return few results.
